findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?utm_source=mcp-registry&utm_medium=directory&utm_campaign=registry-2026-10-10" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: review_code, get_review, list_repos, get_triage_runs, get_triage_diagnostics, build_from_spec · Private data: create_free_account, retry_build, get_build_files, notify_files_written, review_code, get_usage_guide, get_triage_diagnostics · Public sink: continue_build, notify_files_written, review_code, build_batch, build_from_spec · Destructive: test_component, review_code, get_triage_runs, get_triage_diagnostics, build_from_spec.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: review_code, get_review, list_repos, get_triage_runs, get_triage_diagnostics, build_from_spec · Private data: create_free_account, retry_build, get_build_files, notify_files_written, review_code, get_usage_guide, get_triage_diagnostics · Public sink: continue_build, notify_files_written, review_code, build_batch, build_from_spec · Destructive: test_component, review_code, get_triage_runs, get_triage_diagnostics, build_from_spec

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
